label: ORIGINAL_FINALITY_2: ORIGINAL_FINALITY_1 plus dependence on goodness with D-realization fixed
definition: OriginalFinalityForGood good fit fitOf φ s x y: OriginalFinality good fit φ s x y together with E4, non-coincidence of the origin's favouring with goodness, typed as BecauseOfGoodness good fitOf φ s x y (the favouring depends on betterness with the realization of D held fixed): the end operates as good.
note: Analyst reading ORIGINAL_FINALITY_2. Under it original finality requires BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS_2 by definition; the open question becomes whether any noncognitive profile can meet it, which needs goodness to vary within a D-realization class for the contrast (available without counterpossibles where other content differs, as for c over d; counterpossible where betterness is fixed by content) and, for the apprehended plan, the content-generality and SpecifiesGiving-as-dependence bridges. See docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md §§65–69.
